bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
head=6d0997b814f3e634916a0b93f08c87b7fe26d269
git fetch --no-tags origin chat/tgtumbler-gserver-deploy-20261106 >/dev/null 2>&1
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$head" || { echo STK04_SOURCE_SHA_MISMATCH; exit 72; }
d="$(mktemp -d /tmp/gace-stk04-build.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
git archive "$head" | tar -xf - -C "$d"
test -f "$d/artifacts/bot/scripts/ensureStickerTopicPin.ts"
docker build -q -f "$d/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t "gace-stk04-pin:${head%%????????????????????????????????}" "$d" >/dev/null
docker image inspect "gace-stk04-pin:${head%%????????????????????????????????}" --format '{{.Id}}'
printf 'STK04_DEPLOY_IMAGE=BUILT\nSTK04_DEPLOY_SOURCE=%s\n' "$head"
